title: Regroup at the unit boundary (60 minutes, 100 paise)
concept: A bigger unit is made of a fixed number of smaller units: 60 minutes make 1 hour, 100 paise make ₹1.

When the small units add up to that number or more, make one big unit from them and keep the rest as small units. The number to regroup at depends on the unit: 60 for time, 100 for money (10 for ones and tens).

alternative.title: Like carrying, but at 60 or 100
text: Carrying in ones and tens happens at 10. Time carries at 60, money at 100.

members.title: Adding durations: 60 minutes make an hour
Adding rupees and paise: 100 paise make ₹1

responsePatterns.uncertain: the money answer also fits a notation habit (paise written in full after the dot); two different families: guide the shared concept, do not establish either misconception from this pair
